changes: Heroic Aura added at 29.6k (Kieran: support with Heroic Aura; pro Rem buys it 34% late). It takes the weapon slot by selling Opening Rounds, and Tag Along T2 makes its radius and 7s active 35% bigger while you nap.

High-Velocity Rounds now upgrades to Opening Rounds in lane (+800): pro Rem buys HV 96% and Opening Rounds 88% early, and Rem's lane is the type the rules say to fix first. Spirit 4.8k slides to 7.2k (was 6.4k).

Healing Booster now upgrades to Healing Tempo at 46.4k (it was in slot-locked in Kieran's in-game build): Tag Along's burst heal, every hop and Healing Nova all count, so the mate you nap on gets 35% fire rate and move speed. Healing Booster no longer gets sold.

Trophy Collector (1.6k at 17.6k, Kieran's 'maybe') and Enchanter's Emblem (1.6k at 19.2k) replace Refresher and Spirit Burn in core; Refresher goes to rich, Spirit Burn is out (Mystic Reverb keeps the pillow damage in rich). Health lands 4.8k at 11.2k (Nova), 6.4k at 16k, 8k at 17.6k.

Divine Barrier moved up to 26.4k, right after Tankbuster (was 34.4k; pro Rem buys it 83% in mid game, before 20 min). Core 46.4k (was 53.6k), 12 slots: Rapid Recharge, Divine Barrier, Boundless, Tankbuster, Superior Cooldown, Nova, Healing Tempo, Greater Expansion, Trophy, Enchanter's, Heroic Aura, Superior Duration.

Ability order: Consensus: unlock 2, 1, 3, ult, spread T1s (Tag Along, Pillow, Helpers), max Tag Along by point 10, Helpers next, ult at points 12-14, Pillow T2/T3 last. Ours is that path exactly. Kieran's old order is almost the same.

Item fit: Enchanter's Emblem → Restorative Locket (1.6k T2 green, same slot at 19.2k). Emblem's bonus is just 15 spirit and 5% cooldown while above 65% health, and it isn't in tracklock pro Rem's buys, in lockbuilds' top-30 Rem items (lowest shown is 11.1%) or in Kieran's in-game Rem. Restorative Locket is a 32m ally heal that stores up to 25 stacks of 16 heal (+0.45x) from enemy casts nearby, plus 8% spirit resist. Tag Along T2 gives +35% item range while napping, and pro Rem buys it 40% early (tracklock). The Counters and Refresher sell notes now name the Locket.
Healing Tempo moved from core to Slot locked (Kieran: small gain over Healing Booster for a lot of money).

Round 9: Guardian Ward moved from the start of Mid (8k) into Early, right after Opening Rounds (4k). It's the lane item that helps your partner (250 barrier + 2.75m speed on a mate, 40m range, half cooldown when cast on others); tracklock.gg pro Rem, last 30 days to Oct 19, buys it early in 97% of games. Compress Cooldown (the 4.8k spirit item) moves to the start of Mid to keep Early at 8; spirit spike moves from 7.2k to 8k; health 4.8k still lands on Healing Nova.

Round 9: Worth a try box: Scourge (Tag Along T2 gives +35% item duration while napping and self-casts land on your ally, so Scourge's 10s aura of 2.3% max health per second plus 40% spirit resist runs 13.5s on the mate; tracklock pro Rem late 25%) and Ethereal Shift (same self-cast redirect: 4s invulnerable on the ally, untested).

Round 10: Divine Barrier and Tankbuster swapped: Divine Barrier now 24k (was 26.4k), Tankbuster 26.4k (was 21.6k). Saving your mate is the job, and tracklock.gg pro Rem (last 30 days to Oct 19, 95 games) buys Divine Barrier 83% mid; Tankbuster isn't in their top 8 in any phase. Tankbuster still clears 165 on the pillow (75 + 1.6x spirit = 258 at 26.4k).

Round 11: Support already, so no role pivot. Empty 'Team full of gun heroes?' box: Heroic Aura (17% bullet resist, +26% fire rate for the team) moves up to right after Healing Nova (14.4k instead of 29.6k). No 6.4k run.

Round 12: Echo Shard on Tag Along (Kieran: 'the whole point') moves into the core, bought right after Healing Nova and Trophy Collector at 19.2k souls (first 6.4k of the build, spirit 4.8k already at 8k and health at 11.2k). Restorative Locket (fresh 1.6k at 19.2k that you sold for a counter, not Kieran's pick) leaves the core for the slot. Trophy Collector moved from 17.6k to 12.8k so the assist souls stack for longer. 'Worth a try' box removed (Scourge, Ethereal Shift: not Kieran's picks). Reorder box title made concrete: '3+ gun heroes on your team?'. Sells re-pointed (counters: Trophy Collector; Refresher: Superior Duration; Mystic Reverb: Tankbuster). Refresher note: it resets the ult (Naptime), 'two naps' read like Tag Along.

Round 13: notes cut to what a player wouldn't know (UPDATE 3), desc is a short style label (UPDATE 4), Counters notes name the right heroes (Spirit Resilience: real spirit-damage heroes, no Haze; Counterspell: a parryable ability). Echo Shard on Tag Along (Kieran: the whole point) moved to straight after Compress Cooldown, so it's the first big buy after the spirit spike. Extra Charge checked: Pillow Toss has charges in the files (1, 8s between).

Round 14: Healing Nova moved before Echo Shard: health 4.8k now 11.2k (was 17.6k, too late for a support who has to stay alive next to his mate); Echo Shard on Tag Along still the first 6.4k, now 17.6k (was 14.4k, which also broke 'no 6.4k before ~20 min'). Renamed 'Bedtime Story' -> 'Babysitter' (the old name restated Rem's sleep theme instead of the support style). Heroic Aura now says it's only for a team with gun heroes (Kieran's rule). Echo Shard note said to hop to a second mate, which Tag Along already does on its own; it now says what Echo adds (reset after the nap). Opening Rounds' duplicate sell note emptied (Heroic Aura says it). Dispel note had 'Yamato grapple' (not dispellable) - now Disarming Hex; Unstoppable note dropped vague 'CC'; Counterspell example now confirmed parryable. Divine Barrier gets the napping tip (self-casts go to your mate) instead of the site's default note, which called it 'same job as Counterspell'.
Round 15: name 'Rizuhble's Piggyback Healer Rem' (Babysitter was already Dynamo's name). Counters desc was 117 chars (game limit 112): now ends 'Sell Trophy Collector.' (110).

Round 17: Desc '' (only Rem build, always played support). Lane Extra Regen gets 'Sell it once you're out of slots.'. Core Heroic Aura (already 'Only if your team has gun heroes.') now has a 'Swap for Heroic Aura' box: Rescue Beam (same 3.2k): 20% max-health heal on your mate and you, and Tag Along T2 gives +35% item range while napping, so the core works without gun heroes.
Round 19: style check, no change. Support Rem is the only public style (lockbuilds bebungo Oct 18, THETA ZERO, Deathy, Drakyn, Adge; seemeta Oct 5-19).

Round 20: late list to ~80k: Transcendent Cooldown, Healing Tempo, Lightning Scroll (Naptime's wake-up damage carries it), Mystic Reverb, Witchmail (second health step), Refresher moved last (luxury). Slot locked merged in.

Round 23: kit check. Tag Along makes every self-cast item land on the ally and gives +35% item duration while napping (T2), so Scourge (40% spirit resist, 20% debuff resist and a max-health damage aura on your mate) replaces Mystic Reverb in the late list, selling Tankbuster. Lightning Scroll now sells Echo Shard. Superior Duration stays: Naptime's sleep scales with duration (4.75s to 6.1s).

Round 25: points reordered for support: Tag Along T2 (+35% item barrier/duration while napping) at L6-7 and T3 at point 8, ult tiers before Helpers T3. Compress Cooldown moved from the ult to Tag Along.
Slot locked: Transcendent Cooldown, Healing Tempo moved out of the rich box (Kieran rule: tiny-gain expensive upgrades are Slot locked).
